cohort: The study included 49 elective Cesarean section (C-section) cases and 49 normal vaginal term deliveries.
finding: There is differential expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines in elective C-section compared with normal term vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cord blood Interleukin-6 and Interleukin-8 were significantly higher in the vaginal delivery group, while Tumor-Necrosis Factor-a and Granulocyte-Colony Stimulating Factor were significantly higher in the C-section cord blood.
